name: dotclaude
description: Senior-engineer discipline for Claude Code, as two plugins: dotclaude (worktree, pre-flight, guard hooks, code review, testing) and dotclaude-design (design/UX audits). Consumed as-is; each adapts to your project at runtime. Install either or both.

plugins.name: dotclaude
plugins.description: Senior-engineer discipline for Claude Code: worktree isolation, pre-flight, guard hooks, graded code review, risk-weighted test coverage. Consumed as-is; /dotclaude:coding and /dotclaude:testing elicit your project's bar.

plugins.name: dotclaude-design
plugins.description: A design/UX audit layer for Claude Code. /dotclaude:design elicits your design north-star; ux, flow, pages, a11y, interaction, and design-token audits grade every screen against it, plus a product-designer IA/flow spec.
